label: Holistic Loop
description: Investigate → plan → execute → review cycles across the whole initiative. Use when scope is exploratory and the plan must be revised as you learn.
best_for: Coupled work where items can't be validated in isolation
The right plan can only be authored after cross-item investigation
Item shape will shift as the work reveals what items actually are
Replanning is expected — the first plan will be wrong about something material
not_for: Items are independent and stable — use item-level for parallelism
A stable plan already exists and just needs to be drained — use phased-plan-drain
Work is small enough to fit in a single backlog item
tradeoffs: One plan, not N plans — lower replanning cost than item-level for coupled work
Loses parallelism — only one round runs at a time
Initiative-level acceptance review instead of per-item review

prompt.title: Holistic Loop Investigate
prompt.purpose: Investigate initiative-wide code, backlog, and system state and produce holistic findings.

prompt.title: Holistic Loop Plan
prompt.purpose: Produce or update the initiative-wide implementation plan and readiness assessment.

prompt.title: Holistic Loop Execute
prompt.purpose: Execute against the initiative-wide plan and report whether replanning is needed.

fields.name: replan_needed
fields.description: True when execution revealed the plan is materially wrong and the loop must return to investigate.

prompt.title: Holistic Loop Acceptance Review
prompt.purpose: Evaluate holistic-loop results against acceptance criteria and produce an acceptance verdict.

fields.name: verdict
fields.description: Acceptance verdict for the initiative against its acceptance criteria. Use accept / accepted when the criteria are met; changes_requested when specific fixable gaps should be re-executed before acceptance (routes back to execute); any other non-accepting verdict records the gap and reconciles.

prompt.title: Holistic Loop Backlog Reconcile
prompt.trigger: Round refresher auto-starts holistic-loop reconcile after review completes
prompt.purpose: Read prior round artifacts and propose backlog mutations that align the initiative with the work just completed.

fields.name: backlog_sync
fields.description: The proposed backlog reconciliation plan (completed/created/updated items, proposal, rationale).
